sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 741)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Harry Bartell starring in Harry W. Junkin's airborne bomb suspense thriller *Night Flight to Madrid* on *Radio City Playhouse*, Hal Burdick narrating newspaper city-room human-interest drama on *Night Editor* for Edwards Coffee, Irish tenor Morton Downey crooning on *The Coke Club* for Coca-Cola, classic Australian transcriptions of Alonzo Deen Cole's supernatural horror *The Witch's Tale* on 3DB Melbourne, Chuck Schaden's extended biographical interview on *The Mel Blanc Show*, and CBS schedule pre-emption logs for *Our Miss Brooks*, Harry Bartell (1949), Hal Burdick (1938), Morton Downey (1946), Alonzo Deen Cole (1933), and Mel Blanc (1933–1988):
